meta.note: 64 SKU physical-label checks pending (data/Kanon_Product_Verification_Worklist.xlsx). Allergen lines are the safety field.

products.title: Tyson Grilled & Ready strips (Original)
products.notes: Southwestern variety adds wheat+soy; tag per SKU.

products.title: Core Power Elite chocolate shake
products.notes: Dairy-only; stays on a meat fast.

products.title: Quest Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough bar
products.notes: Reformulated to include soy lecithin; milk + almonds. Dairy-based, abstinence-friendly.

products.title: Quest Birthday Cake bar
products.notes: Verify flavor-specific allergens; Quest reformulations add soy.

products.title: David Gold protein bar
products.notes: Contains bovine collagen + porcine gelatin = MEAT; NOT abstinence-friendly. Also milk/soy/coconut/egg.

products.title: Built Puff bar
products.notes: Contains collagen + gelatin = MEAT; NOT abstinence-friendly. Marshmallowy dessert bar (milk, soy). Verify per flavor.

products.title: RXBAR
products.notes: Egg-white + nut + date based; abstinence-friendly (no meat). Verify nuts per flavor.

products.title: Kind Protein bar
products.notes: Nut-based; abstinence-friendly. Verify dairy per flavor.

products.title: Premier Protein shake (vanilla)
products.notes: Milk-protein based; abstinence-friendly. Some contain soy.

products.title: OWYN plant-based shake
products.notes: Pea-protein; vegan, allergen-friendly base; verify nuts.

products.title: Whey protein powder (1 scoop)
products.notes: Whey = dairy; abstinence-friendly. Many add soy lecithin.

products.title: Collagen protein powder (1 scoop)
products.notes: Collagen is bovine = MEAT; NOT abstinence-friendly.

products.title: Halo Top ice cream (1/2 cup)
products.notes: DESSERT = sweets tag. Dairy; abstinence-friendly. Verify per-flavor nuts.

products.title: Yasso frozen Greek yogurt bar
products.notes: DESSERT = sweets. Verify per-flavor (some have nuts).

products.title: Chobani Greek yogurt (plain, nonfat)
products.notes: Plain is NOT sweets; flavored fruit-on-bottom may be.

products.title: Roasted chickpeas (snack)
products.notes: Plant snack; light beans note still applies to meals not snacks.

products.title: Tuna pouch (flavored)
products.notes: Fish; abstinence-friendly. Some flavors add soy.

products.title: Salmon jerky
products.notes: Fish; verify added soy in marinade.

products.title: Protein cookie
products.notes: DESSERT = sweets. Verify; many contain wheat/egg/nuts.

products.title: Beyond Burger patty
products.notes: Pea-protein; allergen-light base; abstinence-friendly. Verify SKU.

products.title: Plant-based ground (crumbles)
products.notes: Verify pea vs soy base per brand.

products.title: Quest Protein Chips
products.notes: Baked, gluten-free, milk-protein based; abstinence-friendly. Verify per-flavor.

products.title: Wonderful Pistachios
products.notes: Tree nut; abstinence-friendly. Complete plant protein.

products.title: Beef jerky
products.notes: MEAT; not abstinence-friendly. Marinade usually soy sauce (soy+wheat).

products.title: Roasted seaweed snack
products.notes: Very light snack; sesame oil in some brands (verify).

products.title: Dark chocolate square
products.notes: DESSERT = sweets. Often milk/soy traces; low protein.

products.title: Salmon jerky
products.notes: Fish; abstinence-friendly. Verify added soy in marinade.

products.title: Cheese and nut snack box
products.notes: Cheese + nuts + fruit; abstinence-friendly. Verify components.
